headline: Experimental and computational tools are refining RNA secondary and 3D structure models
label: Rna Structure Prediction And Validation
summary: Refined tRNA Structure-seq data and FRET-guided model selection now sharpen how RNA structure predictions are checked against experimental readouts.
synthesis: The dominant thread is that RNA structure models are being constrained by experimental or quantum-chemical reference data. A refined tRNA Structure-seq pipeline that incorporates modification data and energy parameters reports 94% accuracy for yeast tRNA secondary structure prediction under mild stress. Separately, MACE-based machine learning potentials are trained on a new quantum mechanical dataset of ApA RNA dimer conformations sampled by TREMD and are compared against SO3LR and MACE-OFF24 for conformational transitions. A published FRET-guided workflow selects RNA 3D structures from RNAComposer, FARFAR2, and AlphaFold3 outputs by comparing FRETraj-computed transfer efficiencies against FRET-derived reference values. The items differ in scale and method, so the shared element is validation of structural models against reference data rather than a single methodological advance.
